item.text: I’m targeting the remaining architectural dependency that still looks wrong: the simulator currently asks the view whether the simulation is viable. I’m going to move population analysis/viability out of the UI path and turn it into a separate simulation-report layer the simulator and view can both consume.

I’m moving simulation analysis out of the view now. The end state is: simulator owns viability decisions, the view only renders, and population counting becomes a reusable immutable report instead of mutable UI state.

I’ve removed the view’s population-analysis state. Next I’m updating the simulator loop to use the shared analyzer for both viability and rendering snapshots so the UI is no longer in the control path at all.
The analysis/render split compiles. I’m doing a quick final sweep for stale references to the deleted stats classes and the old view viability check, then I’ll summarize the outcome.

Refactored the remaining UI/control coupling out of the simulator. `Simulator` no longer asks the view whether the simulation is viable; it now uses [SimulationAnalyzer.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/SimulationAnalyzer.java:7) to build a [PopulationSummary.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/PopulationSummary.java:7) and makes viability decisions itself in [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/Simulator.java:79). The view is now render-only and consumes the precomputed summary through [SimulationSnapshot.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/SimulationSnapshot.java:4) and [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/SimulatorView.java:81).

I also removed the old mutable stats layer entirely. `FieldStats` and `Counter` are gone, replaced by the analyzer/summary pair, and disease-death tracking remains inside [Disease.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/Disease.java:23) rather than leaking into UI state. That leaves clearer boundaries: simulator coordinates, analyzer summarizes, snapshot transports state, and view only draws.

Verified with `javac *.java`. No automated tests exist beyond compilation.
